server_picker.title: {game} Server Picker
server_picker.subtitle: Turn a region's toggle on to block it. Blocked regions can't be matched to you, so matchmaking picks from the ones left open.
server_picker.no_games: Couldn't load the server list. Restart Deadlock+ and try again.
server_picker.unsupported: Blocking servers isn't available on {platform} yet.

unblock_all.title: Unblock all servers?
unblock_all.description_one: This removes all {count} firewall rule Deadlock+ created. Matchmaking will be able to route you to every region again.
unblock_all.description_other: This removes all {count} firewall rules Deadlock+ created. Matchmaking will be able to route you to every region again.

import.title: Import {source} blocks?
import.description: Deadlock+ will recreate these blocks as its own rules, then delete the {source} rules they replace. Any such rule that blocks something outside these regions is left alone.

game_running.title: Deadlock is running
game_running.body: Restart your game after changing anything on this page. Blocks only apply to connections made after the game starts.

presets.title: Presets
presets.description: Save a set of regions to block or keep open, then apply it in one click. Useful for region-locking, like an EU-only preset.
presets.edit_description: Applying a preset sets every region at once. Single-server blocks inside a region are cleared.
presets.mode_allow_note: Listed regions stay open, everything else is blocked.
presets.mode_block_note: Listed regions are blocked, everything else is open.
presets.will_block: {blocked} of {total} regions will be blocked, {open} left open.

row.unblockable: Valve lists no servers for {names}, so it can't be blocked here.
row.block_siblings: Also block {names} to cover more of this route
row.no_reply_hint: No reply after several attempts. The region may be unreachable from your network or drop ping traffic.
row.ping_region: Direct ping to this region's closest server.
row.locked: Blocked because all of {region} is blocked. Unblock the region to change this.
